pr105.title: Rift Forge: twenty active upgrades, exact purchases and safe Auto-Ascend
pr105.body:
## Current checkpoint — required CI and raw artifacts verified

Head [`979ed4a3`](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/commit/979ed4a3cb1e106456f86efacc114c89e825a88b) repairs two stale test contracts found by the first full Forge run. The product and frozen save fixtures are byte-identical to `03b78ce1`. All original assertions remain. All required workflows and their raw artifacts have now been verified. Development integration and its final receipt follow.

## Why this change is needed

Rift Forge has four active tracks. This separate development feature adds sixteen distinct mechanics, bringing the active catalogue to twenty, with explicit prices, unlocks and caps. Debugging also reproduced free purchases at very large represented wallets and old-run effects crossing Auto-Ascend when a retained lifetime counter no longer increments exactly.

## What changes

- Five groups: Core, Boss craft, Rhythm, Resources and Resonance. New mechanics cover boss regeneration/traits, bounded overkill, conditional charge, Support pulses/buffs, cast-resource conversion and Resonate capacity/refills.
- All original IDs, paid levels, old price paths and retained benefits remain. Missing additions normalize to level 0 / queue OFF; raw overcaps are retained with bounded new effects. Lab work, seven-slot capacity, purchases, progression, Auto-Ascend and save format are preserved.
- New finite prices are exact rational geometric totals rounded up once. The independent oracle covers every valid start/count/currency combination.
- Forge and Resonate require exact represented debits. Manual primary-write failure rolls back the staged mutation; a committed primary endpoint remains authoritative after recovery-write failure. Queued purchases retain the existing owning offline transaction.
- Actual run boundaries use a transient object identity. Saved large counters remain untouched; Spillway, Relay and passive time cannot leak across a real Ascend.
- A cached charge reference supplies HUD estimates. Separate conservative bounds preserve Push/Farm intent in uncertain fights, including saved Support deadline precision, pending burst and unsafe tap ordinals.
- Twenty-card previews show native current/next/purchase effects and independent currency colors. Touch, keyboard, paid reloads and the actual last row retain focus and scroll.

## Reproduced defects

1. A wallet of `1e30` could grant Forge levels or Resonate charge with a represented debit of zero.
2. Failed manual primary writes left paid memory mutations behind.
3. Applying the generic floating helper to new inputs misrounded 16 of 598 currency totals by one unit.
4. Rounded saved Support deadlines invalidated a theoretical guaranteed lower DPS bound; the supposedly winning boss actually healed.
5. Retained unsafe tap ordinals invalidated one-in-five Cadence bounds and a first HUD approximation.
6. `ascendCount=1e30` could remain unchanged across a real Auto-Ascend, letting old Spillway damage and Relay charge into the new run. The new enemy incorrectly had 10.5625/11 HP; the fixed source retains 11/11 and zero charge.

Before/after synthetic receipts, portable reproducers and byte-verifiable source reconstruction patches are committed under `docs/qa/forge-expansion-001/`. No complete private user save is added.

## Local verification — exact product source

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| Forge core | PASS: 9,291 assertions, 25 causal negatives, 598 independent currency prices, 448 real funded purchases |
| Charge calibration and boss bounds | PASS: 3,134 assertions, 7 causal negatives, 26 long profiles, 128 finite-window bounds |
| Actual Forge mobile | PASS: 25,524 assertions, 12 profiles, 24 screenshots; runtime errors 0 |
| Actual Node 8.3.0 / V8 6.0.286.52 | PASS: 2,452 assertions; both complete scripts parsed; unsafe-counter Auto-Ascend included |
| Unchanged Luminous Tracking mobile | PASS: both original scenarios, three original viewport/safe-inset profiles each |
| Lab core/boundary/stress | PASS: 2,456 / 2,344 / 2,182, with all required causal controls |
| Prism saved-state / real Ascends | PASS: 3,506 assertions, 180 payouts |
| Lab on actual V8 6.0 | PASS: 580 assertions |
| Source, tooling, identity-verifier self-test, task context, whitespace | PASS |

Mobile profiles use 320/390/430px, CSS root font 16/32px and both motion modes. Root-font scaling doubles rem-relative text; fixed-px text may remain unchanged. Physical Android, native WebView textZoom/60, TalkBack and signed saved-app update acceptance remain open for the later combined release.

## Full-CI failure and repair

[First full run 38043830487](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/actions/runs/38043830487) failed with 210 PASS rows and two FAIL rows: the accessibility fixture used an unrepresentable `1e100` debit, and the timer mutant still searched for the replaced lifetime-counter guard. Both Chrome processes exited 0 without timeout or runtime errors; their QA assertions failed. The subsequent 22-negative and guarded-smoke gates were skipped, so that run is not accepted.

The corrected accessibility fixture funds the actual selected x5 quote of 481,114 Shards and preserves poor → funded → poor and all UI assertions. The timer mutant now targets `ascendRunToken===runBeforePassive`; it still removes the guard, is caught by the original reset-resource oracle, and restores the function. Positive UI, its two intended negative controls, timer boundaries, chronology and farm retention passed locally on the repaired bytes. Source, Node tooling, context and whitespace checks passed.

[Immutable failure and repair evidence](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/tree/979ed4a3cb1e106456f86efacc114c89e825a88b/docs/qa/forge-expansion-001/failed-ci-38043830487) includes the complete lossless raw log, two exact failure results, ZIP/API provenance and local repair receipts. Artifact 11667664409 is 14,963,060 bytes, SHA-256 `712da10b46a6a3e869df3eb8d290db782879887540c0d170818db898c1d14774`.

## Mandatory GitHub acceptance — SUCCESS on corrected head

| Workflow | Run | Status at this checkpoint |
|---|---|---|
| Full pre-merge validation | [38047024745](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/actions/runs/38047024745) | SUCCESS; all 18 steps and raw artifact verified: 182 scenarios / 212 PASS rows / 0 FAIL rows; strict 22-negative gate, guard and smoke succeeded |
| Research Lab expansion validation | [38047024763](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/actions/runs/38047024763) | SUCCESS; all 11 steps and raw artifact verified on corrected head: 2,456 core / 2,344 boundary / 2,182 stress / 3,506 Prism / 6,420 mobile / 580 actual V8 checks |
| Rift Forge expansion validation | [38047024764](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/actions/runs/38047024764) | SUCCESS; all 13 steps and raw artifact verified on corrected head: 9,291 core / 3,134 calibration / 25,524 mobile / 2,452 actual V8 checks; all 17 offline scenarios pass |

Focused raw-artifact audit is complete. Lab artifact **11668255951**: 5,192,547 bytes, SHA-256 `baa94ce212b184182b5be18c0d2f659758198a6d8cb467249675863aebd936c2`. Forge artifact **11668081599**: 5,733,378 bytes, SHA-256 `d2c3f24ccde124b5f282d48f4d09932e3a313965501d00134cb496b38b0f0f02`. Both match GitHub's size and digest, pass ZIP CRC, and record the exact combined commit/source below. All six archived Lab tests and all five Forge tests match head `979ed4a3`. The 8-hour Forge scenario completed 302,400 kills and 14,400 actual Auto-Ascends; live/offline purchase-boundary records agree. Full pre-merge validation also passed and its raw artifact has been verified.

The separate Prism-only runs are branch-filtered skips, not acceptance passes. Required Prism checks run inside the full and Lab workflows. The earlier focused Lab/Forge successes tested `03b78ce1` and remain historical; current acceptance uses the fresh runs on `979ed4a3`.

Full artifact **11668434322**: **14,494,600 bytes**, SHA-256 `91b901f1799e03e1297ed7ef7aa91c68d90232ad5af4b0e21f4a03f9be7b2a6e`; downloaded bytes match GitHub's digest and pass ZIP CRC. The raw behavioral log has 212 PASS rows and zero FAIL rows, with the exact accepted Lab scenario inventory. Both repaired cases pass with the actual 481,114-Shard quote and `negativeOldAccrual: true`. All three historical scroll regressions pass with exit 0 and no timeout.

The full decoded job-log request returned `Transport closed`. Individual raw traces for the 22-negative loop are therefore unavailable; acceptance is supported by the unchanged, exact-head strict 22-case workflow loop and its completed/success GitHub step. This limitation is preserved in the receipt. Both inline scripts are syntax-checked on actual V8 6.0; the complete game IIFE executes with controlled presentation, timers and storage. Native Android acceptance remains separate.

## Verified source and integration boundary

- Head: `979ed4a3cb1e106456f86efacc114c89e825a88b`.
- Base: `5bcd1c861af51511ca3d5c4a07d9d61e72fdff03` on `feature/progression-expansion-2026-10-09` behind draft PR102.
- GitHub synthetic merge: `8e0e4911e6821242369e8a1877a40068bab23a10`, with exactly those two parents.
- Reviewed and synthetic tree: `dd9e503000291554af6e93c294d99d475a09612f`.
- Product SHA-256: `05742431ab6bffefce09d0bebefa754190ed836cc51f4aeeb81e8a9d769419ac`.
- Frozen fixture SHA-256: `ab43604db1b5bce8b9990506f989676dfb0009cdcf2e514a8ccee9da166c8753`.
- Main remains `67373faa531f0bb791c883210ee623320861e380`.

Required CI and raw-artifact audit now accept this exact candidate for development integration. The actual merge tree and fresh integrated checks will be verified immediately afterward. PR102 remains draft. No main merge, APK build, signing or publication. Agent code review is not a human GitHub approval. The final integration identity and immutable evidence link will be added after verification.
